atAGlance: Bánh cuốn is steamed rice rolls, usually with minced pork, wood ear mushroom, fried shallot, herbs, and nước chấm.
whatItIs: Bánh cuốn are delicate steamed rice sheets rolled around minced pork and wood ear mushroom, topped with fried shallots and eaten with herbs, chả, and nước chấm.
howToEnjoy: Spoon nước chấm over the rice rolls gradually, then add herbs and fried shallots to each bite. The sheets are soft, so a light hand keeps them silky.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh cuốn as a breakfast or snack plate, often with chả lụa on the side. Ask for no pork or nước chấm on the side before the plate is finished.
worthKnowing: A good bánh cuốn shop often steams the rice sheets fresh, which is why the rolls feel soft and almost translucent.
goodToKnow: Bánh cuốn is often a breakfast or snack plate with chả lụa on the side. Spoon nước chấm gradually so the rice sheets stay silky.
